ms.promise:
Repository with code and explanation. The publicly accessible repository on FluidTokens GitHub contains all the files and code snippets to integrate BTC Addresses in the ordinary use of Cardano transactions and smart contracts. In this repository, the community will find a Cardano smart contract that behaves as smart account, allowing the Bitcoin wallet to interact with Cardano. In other words, the BTC wallet is interacting with a Cardano smart contract (smart account) that interacts with Cardano users and other smart contracts.
The code is based on Plutus V2, eventually written in Aiken and Lucid.
The ReadMe file of the same repository contains a clear explanation on how to use the code provided to allow BTC Accounts in dApps.
ms.criteria:
The repository contains the code to integrate BTC Accounts with the explanations on how to do it. Users are able to read and use the code, following the steps in the explanation file.
An example of Cardano transaction executed from a BTC wallet is provided.
ms.report:
The first milestone is completed and we were able to interact with Cardano using a Bitcoin wallet, here the results:
・Youtube video explaining the code link
・Repository with the code of the smart contract link
・Transaction of interaction from the bitcoin account to the cardano contract link
・The readme file that explains the code link 
・Added a step by step guide in the readme, cloning the repo, installing aiken, using the bitcoin publickey of the user to the contract to generate the Cardano address, in the milestone number 2 there will be the frontend in order to users that have no dev skills to interact with this project
・Added the documentation regarding the ECDSA offchain signature used, the user is signing the transaction willing to do on Cardano using a bitcoin wallet, then this can be used to propagate the transaction on Cardano

The wallet used in this example was XVerse, a bitcoin hot wallet used to sign the transaction to interact with Cardano smart contract

ms.promise:
In a subdomain of FluidTokens.com website, we create a user-friendly interface where the users can use Bitcoin wallets to execute some examples of Cardano token transfers and to interact with a Cardano smart contract. This is the demo of the code developed in Milestone 1.
The Bitcoin wallet will send Cardano tokens in a transaction through the Cardano smart contract (smart account) without the need of downloading any Cardano wallet. It will also be able to interact with a Cardano smart contract.
ms.criteria:
User can connect their BTC wallet and execute a token transfer from the demo interface as result of the implementation of the code delivered in Milestone 1. Behind the scenes, the BTC wallet connects to the user Cardano smart account (a smart contract) and transfers tokens from it or interacts with a Cardano smart contract.
The link to the demo is added as example in the ReadMe of the project repository.
